info.name: Waai Media - Event Calendar API
info.description:
Official Postman Collection (v2.1) for the Waai Media Event Calendar Module (Laravel 13 API Backend).

### Authentication & Roles
- **Public Endpoints**: No authentication required.
- **Admin Endpoints**: Require Bearer token with 'access' ability (`admin` or `editor` role).
- **Delete Endpoint**: Restricted strictly to `admin` role (returns HTTP 403 Forbidden for `editor`).

### Date & Time Format
- `event_date`: Strict `Y-m-d` format (e.g., `2026-11-20`).
- `event_time`: Valid `H:i` or `H:i:s` format (e.g., `18:30` or `18:30:00`).

### Cover Image Contract (file upload only)
- Event images are accepted ONLY as an uploaded file in the multipart field `cover_image` (jpeg/jpg/png/webp, max 10MB) on create, update and publish. Files are stored in Cloudflare R2 and only the object key is persisted.
- `cover_image_url` is a READ-ONLY, server-generated public URL in responses. Sending it in any create/update/publish request (even unchanged, even null) returns HTTP 422: `The cover_image_url field is read-only...`. React must strip it from edit-form payloads.
- Omitting `cover_image` keeps the current image. A replacement deletes the previous R2 object only after the update is saved (and only if no other event shares it).
- Publish readiness: the event must already have a stored cover or receive a `cover_image` file with the publish request.
- Legacy events whose stored cover is an old external URL keep working untouched until an editor uploads a replacement file.

### Multipart updates (React / file uploads)
PHP does not parse multipart/form-data on real PATCH or PUT requests. To update with a file send `POST /api/v1/admin/events/{id}` as multipart/form-data with the field `_method=PATCH` (see 2.5a). JSON updates of non-file fields may keep using PATCH or PUT (see 2.5). An update with no fields returns 422.
React example: `const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('_method','PATCH'); fd.append('name_en', v); if (file) fd.append('cover_image', file); axios.post(`/api/v1/admin/events/${id}`, fd, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });` (do not set Content-Type manually, never append `cover_image_url`).

### Collection Variables
- `base_url`: Default `https://api.waaimedia.com`
- `token`: Bearer access token for Admin or Editor
- `event_id`: Persisted database ID
- `slug`: Auto-generated or resolved event slug
